title: 有馬記念の後に・ずっと、ずーっと

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara returns, gasping for breath. In an amazing display of running, she took home victory in the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Friends and rivals alike praise her to the high heavens, and Haru Urara is over the moon with happiness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara's Arima Kinen journey comes to a close. She successfully reached her dream race… and won!
